# appgatesdp_protocol_template (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `ports` (List of String) Ports the template pre-populates. Each entry may be a port or port range (e.g. "80", "8000-8080").
- `subtype` (String) IP access subtype this template applies to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
